calculation.description: Equal-weighted reversal of 5-, 20-, 60-, and 120-session returns, each scaled by trailing 60-session realized volatility. The one-day lag ensures only completed-day information is used. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted multi-horizon underperformance and expected subsequent reversal.

validation.validation_notes: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; daily paper IC uses dates with at least 8 valid instruments. The 2020-2023 segment had no valid observations in this retrieved sample because the longest 120-session lookback and available aligned data began later. Results are strongest at longer horizons and remain positive in the recent 2033-2035 regime. Correlation is exploratory artifact-level Spearman correlation against available signal artifacts; deterministic post-Miner audit remains authoritative.
